scope: Only the missing Planned Growth Strategy Part 2 Chapter 3.0 source and the existing family's truthful future form. The settled Part 1 and ten other Part 2 chapter reviews were not repeated.

authoritative_source_search.method: Inspected the official City Council completed-project page and followed its Chapter 3 and entire-report links.
authoritative_source_search.result: The project page explicitly names Chapter 3 - Preferred Alternative Summary and links to lowercase part2-3.pdf. It also labels Part2.pdf as the entire Preferred Alternative report, but the linked PDF is unrelated.

authoritative_source_search.method: Compared the City's Plone collection listing with the project page and saved direct-file sequence research.
authoritative_source_search.result: The collection listing omits Chapter 3, as it also omitted obtainable Chapters 4 and 6 in the saved research. The listing is an incomplete file index.

authoritative_source_search.method: Reviewed the saved 2026-09-11 exact-path probe from the cluster research.
authoritative_source_search.result: The uppercase-P direct path returned HTTP 404. The historical negative probe cannot rule out the lowercase file linked by the City project page.

authoritative_source_search.method: Fetched the official City-hosted original by full GET on 2026-09-23; hashed the fetched bytes and inspected PDF structure, extracted text, and representative rendered pages including maps.
authoritative_source_search.result: HTTP 200, application/pdf, PDF 1.4. It is the missing Chapter 3.0 original.

authoritative_source_search.method: Followed the City project page's apparent entire-Part-2 link and compared its table of contents and 144-page identity with saved family research.
authoritative_source_search.result: It is Part 2 of a separate City/County government-unification study, not the Planned Growth Strategy Preferred Alternative. Saved research already relates it to the complete Structuring A New Urban Government record.

authoritative_source_search.source: City and Bernalillo County government web search
authoritative_source_search.method: Bounded first-party searches for a combined Planned Growth Strategy Part 2 original, including the City project and file hosts and County domain.
authoritative_source_search.result: No verified combined Preferred Alternative original found beyond the misleading Part2.pdf link. This is an evidence limit, not proof that no such original ever existed.

chapter_3_result.printed_pagination_observed: Text pages 131-143, followed by six image-only map pages bearing odd printed folios 145, 147, 149, 151, 153 and 155. The table of contents lists Chapter 3 as pages 131-156; the next chapter begins on printed page 157.
chapter_3_result.substantive_inspection: The opening section explains the preferred alternative's 2000-2025 Albuquerque and Bernalillo County growth objectives. The text and tables cover housing and employment allocations by subarea; rendered Figures 19 and 24 show population and employment change maps. The last six pages are image-only, so extractable-text counts alone understate content.
chapter_3_result.extractable_text: 32,577 characters and approximately 3,115 alphabetic tokens measured by PyMuPDF across the 19-page PDF; six map pages have no text layer.
chapter_3_result.recovery_explanation: The apparent gap was an incomplete historical file capture: the City collection listing omits the file, and the prior filename probe used uppercase Part2-3.pdf while the project page links lowercase part2-3.pdf. The chapter was publicly issued, neither intentionally omitted nor renamed into another chapter.

combined_part_2_result.city_page_claim: The official City project page labels Part2.pdf as Part 2 - Preferred Alternative (entire report).
combined_part_2_result.verified_link_identity: The actual 144-page Part2.pdf is a City/County governmental-unification study, not the Preferred Alternative. Its misleading label cannot establish a complete Planned Growth Strategy Part 2 original.
combined_part_2_result.evidence_limit: No other authoritative combined original was found in this bounded search. An unindexed or offline government original remains possible.

final_family_determination.part_1: Use the one complete 286-page City original, Part1.pdf, as the canonical Part 1 document. Its seven component deliveries remain duplicates; no status change is warranted.
final_family_determination.part_2_chapter_roster: The City project page and Part 2 table of contents list Chapters 1.0 through 11.0. With Chapter 3.0 recovered, all 11 named chapters are represented by 12 separate City PDF deliveries because Chapter 1.0 has two files.
final_family_determination.part_2_completeness: Complete against the official named-chapter roster, but no verified complete combined Part 2 original exists. The 19-page Chapter 3 delivery has nonconsecutive printed map folios, so do not claim page-for-page identity with an unavailable master volume or label the chapter set a complete original report.
final_family_determination.future_presentation: A single curated Planned Growth Strategy family entry: Part 1 as one complete original, then Part 2 as an explicitly labelled City-published chapter/component series with all 11 chapter headings and 12 separate official PDFs in order. State that Chapter 3.0 was recovered from a lowercase official City URL missing from the collection listing, and that the City page's purported entire-Part-2 link points to another study. Do not create a synthetic combined PDF.
final_family_determination.placement_rationale: The historical study is a land-use and growth-planning framework, not an IDO edition, zoning enactment, area-specific sector plan, or transaction. Within the existing site structure, the historical plans page is the closest truthful home if given an explicit citywide-framework heading; the previous Zoning & IDO proposal overemphasized one regulatory aspect. A separate Zoning & IDO cross-listing is not justified at this decision stage.
final_family_determination.duplicate_and_supersession_disposition: No changes. The seven Part 1 component duplicates remain covered by the complete original. All 12 Part 2 files are distinct original deliveries, including the newly recovered Chapter 3. The unrelated Part2.pdf remains governed by its government-unification-study disposition. The three enactment-bill copies remain requires human review for legal-status resolution and are outside this source-recovery task.

scope_assessment.geographic_institutional_scope: City of Albuquerque and Bernalillo County planned-growth policy affecting Albuquerque subareas, infrastructure, redevelopment, land use, and regulatory choices.
scope_assessment.specific_albuquerque_connection: The preferred alternative allocates housing, population, and employment among Albuquerque subareas and maps the City's anticipated growth and infrastructure pattern.
scope_assessment.abqinfo_public_information_value: The family explains a material historical Albuquerque planning framework and the policy choices behind later land-use and infrastructure work. The recovered summary supplies the overview formerly missing from the chapter set.
scope_assessment.general_context_exclusion_test: The record is the City and County's own growth strategy, with substantive Albuquerque policy and mapped allocations; it is not retained merely because statewide or regional context mentions Albuquerque.
scope_assessment.substantive_rationale: Both independent gates pass confidently for the recovered chapter and retained family. The publication-form and misleading-link caveats concern truthful presentation, not mission relevance. No mission-scope-borderline record is warranted.

quality_assessment_for_recovered_chapter.information_density: substantial text, tables, and six image-only growth maps
quality_assessment_for_recovered_chapter.standalone_public_value: high within the Part 2 series because it summarizes the preferred alternative and its Albuquerque subarea allocations
quality_assessment_for_recovered_chapter.series_relationship: serial chapter, not a Part 1 duplicate or replacement for the complete Part 2 volume
quality_assessment_for_recovered_chapter.intended_publication_form: separate official original within one curated Part 2 chapter series
quality_assessment_for_recovered_chapter.substantive_rationale: The official summary supplies important policy and map content previously absent from the delivered set. The authentic PDF must remain distinct, linked in chapter order, with the absence of a verified combined original disclosed.

inventory_effect: One new authoritative Chapter 3.0 candidate approved inventory-only with full positive scope assessment. The 12 already approved Part 1/Part 2 originals retain their statuses; their proposed canonical page is corrected to Area & Sector Plans. No duplicate, superseded, or enactment-bill status changes. No mission-scope-borderline queue addition.
remaining_blockers: No verified authoritative combined Planned Growth Strategy Part 2 original has been located; the City project page's purported complete link is misidentified.
R2 archival, exact public-byte verification, and site presentation remain separate future gates. The three enactment-bill copies still need enacted-ordinance resolution.
safeguards: No archive preparation or R2/storage mutation
